title: Random Effect Challenge
description: This project creates a Challenge where on every block you step, you get a random potion effect.
body:
🎲 Random Effect Challenge

Every step can change everything.

Random Effect Challenge is a lightweight plugin that gives players a random potion effect every time they step on a new block. Whether helpful or harmful, every movement becomes unpredictable and chaotic.

✨ Features

🎲 Random Effects on Movement
Each unique block you walk on triggers a random potion effect.

🌈 Chaotic Gameplay
From powerful buffs to dangerous debuffs — you never know what you’ll get next.

⚙️ Lightweight & Performance Friendly
Designed to run smoothly on servers without unnecessary overhead.

🔥 Survival Challenge Experience
Turns normal movement into a constant risk-versus-reward mechanic.

🧩 Why this plugin?

Walking in Minecraft is no longer safe. Every step becomes a gamble, forcing players to adapt quickly to constantly changing effects.

📦 Compatibility
Works on Spigot/Paper servers
Multiplayer supported
No client mods required
💬 Feedback

Found a bug or have an idea for new effects or mechanics? Feel free to share feedback!
